header: Nonconformity And Corrective Action Procedure Summary
text: This FiftyFive Technologies Policy on nonconformity and corrective action procedure is released for use in FiftyFive Technologies Pvt Limited with effect from 01 January 2026. This document is subject to FiftyFive Technologies Pvt Limited Procedure and subject to change at any time as per the company policy.

header: Nonconformity And Corrective Action Procedure Rule 1
text: Purpose The purpose of this Nonconformity and Corrective Action Procedure is to define the process for identifying, documenting, and addressing nonconformities within FiftyFive Technologies. The procedure ensures that corrective actions are taken to eliminate the causes of nonconformities and prevent their recurrence.

header: Nonconformity And Corrective Action Procedure Rule 2
text: Scope This procedure applies to all departments and processes within FiftyFive Technologies. It covers nonconformities related to products, services, processes, and compliance with internal and external requirements.

header: Nonconformity And Corrective Action Procedure Rule 4
text: Nonconformity: A deviation from specified requirements or standards that affects the quality or compliance of a product, service, or process.

header: Nonconformity And Corrective Action Procedure Rule 5
text: Corrective Action: Actions taken to eliminate the causes of nonconformities to prevent their recurrence.

header: Nonconformity And Corrective Action Procedure Rule 6
text: Preventive Action: Actions taken to eliminate the causes of potential nonconformities to prevent their occurrence.

header: Nonconformity And Corrective Action Procedure Rule 8
text: 1 Identification of Nonconformities

header: Nonconformity And Corrective Action Procedure Rule 9
text: Detection: Identify nonconformities through various means, including inspections, audits, customer feedback, or employee reports.

header: Nonconformity And Corrective Action Procedure Rule 10
text: Documentation: Document the nonconformity in a Nonconformity Report (NCR), including details of the issue, the affected area, and any immediate actions taken.

header: Nonconformity And Corrective Action Procedure Rule 11
text: 2 Evaluation of Nonconformities

header: Nonconformity And Corrective Action Procedure Rule 12
text: Impact Assessment: Evaluate the impact of the nonconformity on product quality, service delivery, or compliance. Determine whether the nonconformity affects customer satisfaction or poses a risk to the organization.

header: Nonconformity And Corrective Action Procedure Rule 13
text: Root Cause Analysis: Conduct a root cause analysis to identify the underlying causes of the nonconformity.

header: Nonconformity And Corrective Action Procedure Rule 14
text: 3 Corrective Action Planning

header: Nonconformity And Corrective Action Procedure Rule 15
text: Action Plan: Develop a Corrective Action Plan (CAP) to address the root causes of the nonconformity. The plan should include specific actions, responsible individuals, and deadlines for completion.

header: Nonconformity And Corrective Action Procedure Rule 16
text: Approval: Obtain approval for the Corrective Action Plan from relevant stakeholders or management.

header: Nonconformity And Corrective Action Procedure Rule 17
text: 4 Implementation of Corrective Actions

header: Nonconformity And Corrective Action Procedure Rule 18
text: Execution: Implement the corrective actions as outlined in the plan. Ensure that actions are carried out effectively and according to the specified timeline.

header: Nonconformity And Corrective Action Procedure Rule 19
text: Communication: Communicate the corrective actions to all affected parties and provide any necessary training or support.

header: Nonconformity And Corrective Action Procedure Rule 20
text: 5 Verification of Effectiveness

header: Nonconformity And Corrective Action Procedure Rule 21
text: Follow-Up: Verify the effectiveness of the corrective actions by monitoring the affected processes or products. Ensure that the nonconformity has been resolved and that no new issues have arisen.

header: Nonconformity And Corrective Action Procedure Rule 22
text: Review: Conduct a review to assess whether the corrective actions have achieved the desired outcomes and prevented recurrence of the nonconformity.

header: Nonconformity And Corrective Action Procedure Rule 23
text: 6 Documentation and Records

header: Nonconformity And Corrective Action Procedure Rule 24
text: Record Keeping: Maintain records of nonconformities, corrective actions, and their effectiveness. Ensure that records are accessible for review and auditing purposes.

header: Nonconformity And Corrective Action Procedure Rule 25
text: Reporting: Report the status and outcomes of corrective actions to management and relevant stakeholders.

header: Nonconformity And Corrective Action Procedure Rule 26
text: 7 Preventive Actions (if applicable)

header: Nonconformity And Corrective Action Procedure Rule 27
text: Identification: Identify potential nonconformities and areas for improvement through risk assessments or other proactive measures.

header: Nonconformity And Corrective Action Procedure Rule 28
text: Action Planning: Develop and implement preventive actions to address potential issues before they result in nonconformities.

header: Nonconformity And Corrective Action Procedure Rule 29
text: Monitoring: Monitor the effectiveness of preventive actions and adjust as necessary to ensure continued effectiveness.

header: Nonconformity And Corrective Action Procedure Rule 30
text: Roles and Responsibilities

header: Nonconformity And Corrective Action Procedure Rule 32
text: Oversight: Oversee the nonconformity and corrective action process, including the review and approval of corrective action plans.

header: Nonconformity And Corrective Action Procedure Rule 33
text: Support: Provide guidance and support for identifying nonconformities and implementing corrective actions.

header: Nonconformity And Corrective Action Procedure Rule 34
text: 2 Department Managers

header: Nonconformity And Corrective Action Procedure Rule 35
text: Implementation: Ensure that corrective actions are implemented within their respective departments and that affected personnel are informed.

header: Nonconformity And Corrective Action Procedure Rule 36
text: Monitoring: Monitor the effectiveness of corrective actions and report any issues to the Quality Manager.

header: Nonconformity And Corrective Action Procedure Rule 38
text: Reporting: Report nonconformities and potential issues to their supervisors or designated personnel.

header: Nonconformity And Corrective Action Procedure Rule 39
text: Compliance: Follow corrective action plans and contribute to the resolution of nonconformities.

header: Nonconformity And Corrective Action Procedure Rule 40
text: Policy Compliance and Enforcement

header: Nonconformity And Corrective Action Procedure Rule 42
text: Regulatory Requirements: Ensure that corrective actions comply with applicable laws, regulations, and industry standards.

header: Nonconformity And Corrective Action Procedure Rule 43
text: Internal Audits: Conduct regular audits to assess compliance with this procedure and identify areas for improvement.

header: Nonconformity And Corrective Action Procedure Rule 45
text: Disciplinary Actions: Failure to adhere to this procedure may result in disciplinary action, up to and including termination of employment. Ensure that actions are consistent with company policies and legal requirements.

header: Nonconformity And Corrective Action Procedure Rule 46
text: Procedure Review and Updates This procedure will be reviewed annually or as needed to ensure it remains current and effective. Updates will be communicated to all employees and relevant stakeholders.
